entities.summary: Morgan Moses is an American professional football offensive tackle for the New England Patriots of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Virginia Cavaliers and was selected by the Washington Redskins in the third round of the 2014 NFL draft. He has also played for the New York Jets and Baltimore Ravens.
